visitas-virtuales.summary: Virtual tour platform for educational centers, built as a Full Stack Developer at Master D.
visitas-virtuales.description: A web platform that lets educational centers offer interactive virtual tours of their facilities. I worked on the React and TypeScript frontend, the integration between Unity (C#) and the web, and a Points of Interest (POI) editor in Unity used to configure the virtual environments. Built in a remote team using GitHub, Jira and agile methodology.
challenges: Connecting a Unity (C#) application with a React web frontend.
Making virtual environments easy to configure without editing Unity code.
Coordinating work and code within a remote team.
solutions: Built the communication between Unity and the web so both stay in sync.
Developed a Points of Interest (POI) editor in Unity to configure each virtual environment.
Organized tasks in Jira and code in GitHub, following an agile methodology.
learnings: Integrating a game engine with a modern web application.
Building internal tools that make content easier to manage.
Working effectively in a remote agile team.
